mapper.sql: SELECT cpd.id, cpd.base_currency_id, cpd.quote_currency_id, cpd.forward_precision, cpd.reverse_precision, cpd.created_at, cpd.updated_at, bc.code AS base_currency_code, qc.code AS quote_currency_code FROM currency_pair_definition cpd INNER JOIN currency bc ON bc.id = cpd.base_currency_id INNER JOIN currency qc ON qc.id = cpd.quote_currency_id
mapper.select: WHERE (cpd.base_currency_id = #{baseCurrencyId} AND cpd.quote_currency_id = #{quoteCurrencyId}) OR (cpd.base_currency_id = #{quoteCurrencyId} AND cpd.quote_currency_id = #{baseCurrencyId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency_pair_definition (base_currency_id, quote_currency_id, forward_precision, reverse_precision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{baseCurrencyId}, #{quoteCurrencyId}, #{forwardPrecision}, #{reversePrecision}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE currency_pair_definition SET forward_precision = #{forwardPrecision}, reverse_precision = #{reversePrecision}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
